regime_context: The TSX thematic detector shows Base Metals & Copper as the clear leader, supported by full breadth, firm durability (0.73), and no crowding. Big Banks is the only crowded challenger. The absolute-trend gate is validated for risk control, while momentum rank serves as an attention lens only. The rotation structure is broad but not directional; no single narrative dominates.
emerging_watch: Watch for a potential leadership rotation: if Big Banks overtakes Base Metals & Copper with a rank-1 margin exceeding 0.5 for five consecutive trading days, that would confirm a handoff and retire the watch. Until then, the leader remains unchallenged.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The theme leads with the highest momentum score, full constituent breadth, and solid durability, while the validated absolute-trend gate should help limit drawdown if the trend falters. The lean is not a return forecast but a risk-aware tilt toward the strongest coincident trend coherence in a regime where the gate has historically improved risk-adjusted outcomes.
evidence: backtest_verdict: absolute_trend_gate validated for drawdown control, gate_helps = true
theses.dissent: Copper is highly sensitive to global macro shocks (e.g., China slowdown, recession fears) that could reverse the trend rapidly; durability is only moderate (0.73) and momentum has no predictive edge.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 4% over any rolling 10-day period before the 30-day horizon.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: This theme shows a weakening trend (score -0.365, low breadth 0.308, mean-revert hurst) and has historically been a defensive sector. While the absolute-trend gate may exit early, the weak momentum and low cohesion argue against maintaining benchmark weight in a risk-controlled framework; the lean is a modest underweight bias.
evidence: rank 8, score -0.365, eligible but hurst mean-revert
theses.dissent: If interest rate expectations shift dovish or equity volatility spikes, utilities could suddenly outperform as a safe haven, reversing the recent weakness.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 5% in any consecutive 10 trading days before the 20-day horizon.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
